title: Init Generator Schema
description: Registers the @nx-extensions/helm plugin in nx.json, so every Chart.yaml becomes a chart project. Run by `nx add @nx-extensions/helm`.

remote.description: OCI registry the chart projects push to, e.g. `oci://ghcr.io/my-org/charts`.

plainHttp.description: Use plain HTTP for an OCI registry without TLS.

release.description: Add a `charts` release group to nx.json, so `nx release` versions the chart projects.
